localidad: Arauca, Tame, Vda. Sabanas de la Vieja, Predio El Oso
comentarios: Eleven individuals, subdivided on 2 or 3 individuals. Just 3 minutes before were flew 15 individuals more in the same directions (south-north), (N 06°22.792'; W 71°54.522; 718m). They crossed open areas between evergreen (Andean lower montane forest) big patches, and flew over the canopy of semi-deciduous forest. More or less 30 m between recorder and birds.
